source.book: Numerology With Tantra, Ayurveda, and Astrology: A Key to Human Behavior
source.author: Harish Johari

introduction: Rules people born on day 2, 11, 20, or 29, or whose destiny/name number totals 2.
Moon = most important planet for Earth/life; reflects sunlight, gives life-nurturing energy.
Known as lord of herbs/medicinal plants; called Soma (nectar).
Governs psyche/subconscious, imagination, sensitivity, sentimentality; rajasic, receptive, changeable.
Gives fluctuating nature, love of aromas/water/nurturing/privacy; natives moody, prone to coughs/colds/skin/heart issues.
Fair, round-faced, curly hair typical; lower body often more attractive than upper.
Rules Cancer, exalted in Taurus; debilitated in Capricorn, falls in Scorpio.
Friends: Sun, Mars, Jupiter. Enemies: Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu.
Peaceful, justice-loving, tender, sensuous, art/music/poetry lovers; women especially feminine/beautiful.
Mucus-dominated temperament. Rules left eye, left nostril, left body side, right brain hemisphere.

psychicNumber: Born 29th are most fortunate of this group.
Tender, artistic, romantic, peaceful, gentle; imaginative but lack follow-through/determination — need guides to execute ideas.
Moon's waxing/waning causes emotional highs and lows, especially in women; those born on the 20th feel this most strongly.
Reflect their environment; as reformers/writers they push social change; devoted to selfless service.
Refined aesthetic sense; women especially enjoy perfumes, fragrant cooking, fragrant baths.
Romantic and quick-changing; don't restrict themselves to one partner despite being family-oriented.
When hurt, become tenacious fighters who won't back down.
Embody the Moon's mother-principle qualities (forbearance, love, care) except patience; treat friendship as sacred, self-sacrificing.
Sociable, dependent on others, good peacemakers/diplomats/travelers, cosmopolitan outlook.
Dislike others planning for them; value freedom; less courageous/ambitious than other numbers.
Reserved, shy, honest to a fault — sometimes exploited for it.
Worry/fantasize a lot; impatient but rarely need to apologize; repeat the same mistakes without changing.
Dislike logic/criticism; when Moon is poorly placed, become mistrustful, anxious, and easily flattered/cheated.
Intuitive; skilled in love and beauty; bold and firmly decisive within a harmonious group.
Good conversationalists/speakers when destiny number and Moon placement are both strong; otherwise argumentative and doubtful.
Tend to accept others' opinions passively, can't say no to demanding people.
Attractive, easily satisfied — which makes them less driven/practical.
Men of this number are trusted by and can influence women easily.
Should avoid partnering with destiny-number-5 people on projects.
elevenBirthday: 11 is the 'mystic number' across traditions (Babylonian TIAMAT myth, 11 forms of Rudra, Joseph's dream in Genesis).
In Hindu tradition 11 is auspicious/dynamic (1 repeated = obstinate, revolutionary, authoritative), not the 'sinner's number' of some Western traditions.
Quick to respond, optimistic, capable of guiding others through crisis if given good guidance.
Still carry core 2 traits: fickle-minded, periodic separation from partners, emotional highs/lows — but become famous/respectable later in life.
Extra-sensitive to vibrations/spirits; like personalized rituals to focus their attention.
precautions: Don't lose courage or fall in love too quickly.
Become independent — don't wait on others or delay work for their sake.
Don't leave jobs unfinished from loss of interest; stick to decisions.
Avoid rushing; practice meditation/mind control; pearl powder with honey before bed helps nervousness.
Watch diet for stomach/heart sensitivity (avoid constipating foods).
Limit friendships with the opposite sex — too many becomes draining.
Avoid contact with infectious illness (weak immune system); morning walks/massage help.
Learn the Moon's strong/weak periods; avoid neck/chest exposure when ill.
Avoid anger (can trigger hysteria in their delicate constitution).
Don't decide big matters at full Moon, when Moon-rise nears Sun-rise, or near large bodies of water — mid-cycle is best.
Take up outdoor sports/hobbies to build physique.
destinyNumber: Generally weaker as a destiny number alone, but psychic-2 + destiny-2 together is the strongest, most confidence-building combination.
All-2 combination (psychic/name/destiny) risks mental instability/indecision unless Moon is well placed.
Face major ups-and-downs; opportunities can slip away right at the point of success.
Insecure/less successful in love; men can be blamed unfairly, women get blamed in love affairs.
Men study hard to build knowledge; strong self-respect, well-mannered, live by reciprocity.
With good support/confidence, capable of remarkable achievement in their field.
Love of water features (rivers, lakes, springs); enjoy group living/company, sometimes delaying important matters for social reasons.
Strong intuition — can read others deeply.
Men marry educated, beautiful women and have virtuous female relatives; often short in stature.
Women are emotional, devoted, stylish, youthful-looking.
Drawn to herbs/gardening/redecorating; suited to psychology, writing, therapy, medicine, acting, dance.
Selfless — don't need appreciation for service; good at counseling couples.
After 35, drawn to occult sciences, philosophy, spiritual life.
sections.nameNumber: Brings gentleness and youthfulness; calming when in harmony with destiny number, helpful for fame. Can bring life changes but success in import/export or herbal-remedy business; draws help especially from women (elders in particular).
sections.weakPeriods: December, January, February — expect physiological/psychological difficulty.
sections.strongPeriods: June 20 - July 27 ('House of the Moon') — best for business promotion, travel, auspicious activity, future planning.
sections.goodDates: 2, 11, 20, 29 are good; 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25 also beneficial, especially on a Monday.
sections.goodDays: Monday is best; extra strong on 1, 2, 4, 7, 10, 11, 13, 16, 19, 20, 22, 25, or 29; a Sunday on those dates also works well.
sections.favorableColors: White (primary — Moon's color, carry a white handkerchief to reset mood); also light green (mental power), blue, cream, grape (nerves).
preciousStones: Pearl is the primary gemstone (min. 4 rattikas / 9 chav 16 points ≈ 3.5 carats).
Alternatives: crystal, quartz, moonstone, greenish/white agate, jade.
Buy/receive from jeweler on a Monday during the ascending lunar cycle, after proper rituals.
Women can wear pearl as necklace, arm band, or skin-touching setting.
Pearl powder used for electrochemical healing.
sections.meditation: Meditate on Lord Shiva; alternatively on a pearl, crystal, moonstone, or quartz.
sections.deity: Shiva, seated on a tiger skin in lotus posture, holding a trident, blessing with the other hand, water streaming from his matted locks, smiling.

mantra.text: AUM SOM SOMAYE NAMAH—AUM (or) AUM SHRIM KRIM CHAM CHANDRAYE NAMAH—AUM
mantra.repetitions: 11,000 times within the ascending lunar cycle

yantra.description: Yantra of the Moon — 3x3 numerical magic square (kamea)

healthAndDiseases: Heart issues from emotional sensitivity — avoid family emotional conflict; pearl powder, Rudraksha bead, silver-glass water, meditation, fasting from speech or sleep on full-moon days helps.
Weak digestion: indigestion, constipation, appetite loss, gas.
Weak immune system, prone to infection.
Liver disorders from love of sweets and irregular eating.
Colds, coughs, lung issues from mucus dominance.
Recommended: regular massage, morning black pepper + honey, fenugreek in soups, almond paste, avoid coffee/tobacco/constipating food, monthly lemon-water inner cleanse, homemade buttermilk.
sections.fasting: Fast Mondays; after sunset avoid salt/spices/grains/pulses/solid food — herbal tea (mint, dandelion, fenugreek) or fresh juice, or buttermilk/lemon water instead. Full-moon fasting is especially beneficial.
sections.friendship: Good friends: other 2s (born 2, 11, 20, 29) and people born on 4, 6, 8, 9.
romance: Naturally drawn to 1s, 2s, 7s, 8s, 9s; not ideally romantic themselves.
1s and 9s are very good matches; 7s and 8s good too (and help spiritual growth).
4s or 5s bring difficulty but still aid personal growth.
Ideal romantic partners: 1, 2, 7, or 9 people born between June 20 and July 27.
sections.specialNote: Psychic/destiny 2 people tend to have to do everything at least twice — it's rare they succeed on the first attempt, which costs them extra time/money/energy for the same result.

relationships.1: Moon (2) is benefited by Sun (1) — converts harsh solar energy into gentler lunar energy, and 2s help 1s shed bad habits, acting as good company/therapists. 1s dominate though, so not ideal for marriage (though if they do marry, the 1 benefits). 1s make good protective friends and are safe, fair business partners even though 2s effectively serve as the junior partner.
relationships.2: Like repels like — short-lived friendships despite shared wavelength; both change their minds too often for a stable business or marriage (divorce likely). Works only with clearly marked responsibilities/territory.
relationships.3: Jupiter (3, a disciplined teacher figure) is a friend but neutral to the Moon. 3s give good, sympathetic advice but aren't ideal spouses/business partners since 2s crave change and 3s crave routine. Good teacher-student dynamic for 2s' interest in the occult, though a lasting guru-disciple bond is hard.
relationships.4: Rahu (4) is an enemy of both Sun and Moon, yet 2s are naturally attracted to 4s and grow from the relationship. Difficult as a destiny-number pairing except in marriage/business, where both partners gain peace and prosperity. Early marital difficulty (2-man/4-woman) still leads to good long-term outcomes, though domestic life may suffer while business thrives. A 2 with destiny number 4 may see marriage delayed but improving with time.
relationships.5: Mercury (5) is not a friend of the Moon — imperfect harmony. Destiny-5 partners bring family/children/parent problems and self-criticism; marriages rarely last past 4-5 years; not a good life or business partnership.
relationships.6: Venus (6), though a universal friend, is neutral to the Moon. Good friendship but not ideal as spouses or business partners — 6s gain more (money, fame) from the pairing than 2s do, especially when the 2 is a man and 6 a woman. Still, friendships/business between them stay mutually beneficial overall.
relationships.7: Ketu (7) is an enemy and exact opposite of 2, yet the Moon's path must pass through Ketu's node — so 2s benefit from 7s (not vice versa). 7s guide 2s well but don't make an ideal couple. As an odd/dynamic number paired with an even/static one, the friendship still produces positive results for the 2.
relationships.8: Saturn (8) is neutral to the Moon; both being even/static numbers, the relationship itself is static — fair but not very beneficial friendship or business. Women should avoid marrying 8-men (though 8-women pose no harm to 2-men). 2s can use 8s' services without much give in return.
relationships.9: Mars (9) is a friend/protector of the Moon — an ideal friend, business partner, or spouse for a 2 of either gender, giving a warm, loving, mutually energizing relationship. 2s are specifically advised to seek out a 9 partner.
